kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتشانأ (form VI)
# نَتَشَانَأُ (natašānaʔu) /na.ta.ʃaː.na.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
# نَتَشَانَأَ (natašānaʔa) /na.ta.ʃaː.na.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
# نَتَشَانَأْ (natašānaʔ) /na.ta.ʃaː.naʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَانَأَ (tašānaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
